title: Qubit-excitation-based adaptive variational quantum eigensolver
problem_summary: Introduces QEB-ADAPT-VQE: constructs ansatze from qubit-excitation evolutions (which obey qubit commutation relations, unlike fermionic excitation evolutions) grown adaptively, reported to outperform qubit-ADAPT-VQE in circuit efficiency and convergence speed while requiring asymptotically fewer gates.

components.notes: Qubit-excitation evolutions obey qubit commutation relations, distinguishing this pool from fermionic-excitation-based ADAPT-VQE.

workflow_composition_notes: Same adaptive-growth VQE loop pattern as ADAPT-VQE, with the operator pool restricted to qubit-excitation evolutions rather than fermionic excitations.
